claims.statement: For orthonormal u,v with coordinate two-frame leverage at most 1/2, <u,X>+c(<v,X>-v0)^2 has a continuous C0 density bounded by 8/sqrt(|c|).

For orthonormal w,v,b with three-frame leverage at most 1/2 and lambda beta nonzero, (L,lambda(V-v0)^2+beta B) has continuous joint density bounded by 16/sqrt(|lambda beta|); off-fold this gives 16/(|lambda|r) when |beta|>=|lambda|r^2.

Under the same diffuse frame, at beta=0 the off-fold subprobability pushforward density is bounded by 4/(|lambda|r), using the continuous (L,V) projection density cap 4 and the exact quadratic Jacobian.

A diffuse Walsh orthonormal triple with row leverage 3/n has, for every rotating normal n_theta in span(v,b), squared physical pair minors summing to 1 but absolute minors summing to at least n/2. Thus Cauchy-Binet followed by separate reciprocal physical-pair payment cannot itself yield a dimension-free curved-section bound.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: On three pairwise disjoint original-coordinate banks, ||p_L||inf, ||p_V||inf, ||p_B||inf <= sqrt(e); the off-fold quadratic Jacobian plus genuine independence gives ||p_(L,Y;off)||inf <= e/(|lambda|r) for every beta.
